description: This file defines the XmlResponse class, which is a specialized HTTP response class for returning XML payloads in a web application. It extends a base Response class and provides functionality to accept XML data as a string or stream, setting appropriate headers and status codes.

classes.name: XmlResponse
classes.description: A response class for returning XML data with appropriate headers and status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an XmlResponse object with given XML data, status code, and headers.

methods.name: createBody
methods.description: Creates the message body stream from XML string or stream, throwing exception on invalid input.
